title: Correct review #964 findings 1-3: consumer candidate completeness, variant members and lineage-map mutations in verify_method.py
body:
## Goal
Correct the three non-blocking findings of review #964 (staged `.session/inputs/964-uff-review-0225.md`, Findings section):
1. Consumer candidates are not checked for completeness (`benchmark/writing/verify_method.py` near line 789 uses `complete=False`); consumer artifact-0087 in `benchmark/writing/method.json` (about lines 955-960) omits candidate-0043, which `benchmark/lineage.json` lists. Add candidate-0043 (read lineage.json yourself to confirm), switch to complete checking, add a rejected mutation.
2. `variant_member_artifacts` and the `source` line anchor (method.json about :943) are not enforced. Enforce both from the files, one rejected mutation each.
3. Add mutations for `lineage-map-group` and `lineage-map-tasks`.
Then update the README rejected count to the verifier's new `rejected_count` (above 64) and re-pin every changed file in `benchmark/writing/current-pins.json`. Expected changed files: verify_method.py, method.json, README.md, current-pins.json. Expected gain: #964 f1-f3 closed; the next review reads the new lines.
Do not edit `benchmark/writing/verification.json` (UF-G is the next task), `benchmark/protocol.md`, frozen dated checkers or historical pin maps. Report, do not fix, anything else.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Each new or changed check is cited by `verify_method.py` line and names the method.json key it reads.
- [ ] method.json consumer artifact-0087 lists candidate-0043, with the lineage.json line that shows it.
- [ ] `python3 -I -B benchmark/writing/verify_method.py` exits 0; report its last line, the new `rejected_count` and the names of the new mutations.
- [ ] README states the same rejected count the verifier prints.
- [ ] `python3 -I -B benchmark/writing/build_addendum.py --check` exits 0.
- [ ] Every entry of every live pin map listing a changed file matches disk (`benchmark/writing/current-pins.json`, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` protected_inputs_sha256, `benchmark/preparation.json`); list the maps checked and the mismatch count.
- [ ] sha256 of `benchmark/protocol.md` and `benchmark/writing/verification.json` recorded unchanged.
- [ ] No `__pycache__` under `benchmark/`.

## Verification
`python3 -I -B benchmark/writing/verify_method.py`

## Context
- Review #964 was CLEAR for R13a, #954 f2/f4 and the new verifier checks; these findings are its residuals. Tree it reviewed: verify_method.py 67b934d6..., method.json 195697bf..., current-pins.json 63cfe6da....
- Historical maps and dated checkers drift by design (README.md:60,66); do not run, re-pin or survey them.
- No session can run LabVIEW; claim no LabVIEW behaviour.
- Run python with `-I -B`. Check files by reading or hashing, never with `git status` (the worker dir is not a git repository). Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits.
- If the CLI answers "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session", that is a native-tool refusal; propose the same operation as a broker JSON action (orchestrator skill, Role tools section, Policymaker #854). Never stop on it.
- Grep is literal-substring only; one pattern per call. Put long python helpers in files under `.session/` (#743).

## Budget
Read: `.session/inputs/964-uff-review-0225.md` (Findings only); `benchmark/writing/verify_method.py` by Grep ranges around the lineage_map code (do not read it whole); `benchmark/writing/method.json` lines 930-970; `benchmark/lineage.json` only by Grep for candidate-0043 and artifact-0087; `benchmark/writing/README.md` line 44 area; `benchmark/writing/current-pins.json`. Short command output; report early if past 30 turns.
